title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 39
description: Ten questions on Genesis 39: Joseph in Potiphar's house, the false accusation and Joseph in prison.

questions.text: From whom did Potiphar buy Joseph?
questions.explanation: Potiphar, an Egyptian officer of Pharaoh's, bought Joseph from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down to Egypt.

questions.text: For whose sake did Yahweh bless the Egyptian's house?
questions.explanation: From the time Potiphar made Joseph overseer, Yahweh blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake.

questions.text: What was the only thing Potiphar still concerned himself with?
questions.explanation: Potiphar left everything in Joseph's hand and didn't concern himself with anything except the food which he ate.

questions.text: How does the text describe Joseph's appearance?
questions.explanation: Genesis 39:6 says Joseph was well-built and handsome.

questions.text: Against whom did Joseph say he would sin if he did what his master's wife asked?
questions.explanation: Joseph asked, "How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?"

questions.text: By what did Potiphar's wife catch Joseph, so that he left it in her hand and ran outside?
questions.explanation: She caught him by his garment, and he left his garment in her hand and ran outside.

questions.text: According to Potiphar's wife, why had a Hebrew been brought into the house?
questions.explanation: She told the men of her house, "He has brought a Hebrew in to us to mock us."

questions.text: Where did Joseph's master put him after hearing his wife's words?
questions.explanation: Joseph's master put him into the prison, the place where the king's prisoners were bound.

answers.text: Into a pit in the wilderness
Out into the fields to work
Into the prison for the king's prisoners
Into Pharaoh's palace as a servant

questions.text: In whose sight did Yahweh give Joseph favor while he was in prison?
questions.explanation: Yahweh was with Joseph and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

questions.text: What did the keeper of the prison commit to Joseph's hand?
questions.explanation: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners who were in the prison.

answers.text: All the prisoners in the prison
